SELECT SKUKEY , DESC01 , SKUG05 , DUOMKY , DESC02 , DESC04
, LOTL04 , NVL(TRIM(LOTL05), LOTL06) AS PHONE , DECODE(LOTL07, ' ', LOTL07, LOTL07 || '@' || LOTL08) AS EMAIL , ' ' AS LEADTM , ' ' AS HSCODE , ' ' AS ATTACH FROM SKUMA WHERE SKUKEY = #{SKUKEY} AND OWNRKY = #{OWNRKY}

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(CONFIM) FROM SHPRQ WHERE SHPOKY=#{DOORKY}) = 'D' THEN 'VALID_M1577' WHEN NVL((SELECT INDDCL FROM SHPDH WHERE SHPOKY = #{DOORKY}),' ') = 'V' THEN 'VALID_M1578' WHEN NVL((SELECT MAX(TRNSHP) FROM SHPRQ WHERE SHPOKY = #{DOORKY}), ' ') != ' ' AND NVL((SELECT INDDCL FROM SHPDH WHERE SHPOKY = (SELECT MAX(TRNSHP) FROM SHPRQ WHERE SHPOKY = #{DOORKY})),' ') = ' ' THEN 'VALID_M1579' WHEN NVL((SELECT MAX(TRNSHP) FROM SHPRQ WHERE SHPOKY = #{DOORKY}), ' ') != ' ' AND (CASE WHEN NVL((SELECT MAX(MENGE_R) FROM IFWMS103 WHERE USRID2 IN (SELECT SVBELN FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = (SELECT MAX(TRNSHP) FROM SHPRQ WHERE SHPOKY = #{DOORKY})) AND STATUS IN ('A','C') AND IFFLG IN ('N','Y')),0) > 0 THEN 'V' ELSE ' ' END) = ' ' THEN 'VALID_M1580' ELSE 'OK' END VALCHK FROM DUAL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM RECDH RH LEFT OUTER JOIN RECDI RI ON RH.RECVKY = RI.RECVKY WHERE RH.INDRCN != 'V' AND RI.LOTA07 = #{EBELN}

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT GLOUSR.FN_WMS_DN_SCAN_CHECK(#{EBELN}) FROM DUAL) = 'E' THEN 'VALID_M1602' WHEN (SELECT GLOUSR.FN_WMS_DN_SCAN_CHECK(#{EBELN}) FROM DUAL) = 'E-TL0502' THEN 'VALID_M1603' WHEN (SELECT GLOUSR.FN_WMS_DN_SCAN_CHECK(#{EBELN}) FROM DUAL) = 'E-TL0503' THEN 'VALID_M1604' ELSE 'OK' END AS MSG FROM DUAL

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT GLOUSR.FN_WMS_DN_SCAN_DEL_CHECK(#{EBELN}, #{DOC_ATTACH_ID}) FROM DUAL) = 'E' THEN 'VALID_M1602' WHEN (SELECT GLOUSR.FN_WMS_DN_SCAN_DEL_CHECK(#{EBELN}, #{DOC_ATTACH_ID}) FROM DUAL) = 'E-TL0502' THEN 'VALID_M1603' WHEN (SELECT GLOUSR.FN_WMS_DN_SCAN_DEL_CHECK(#{EBELN}, #{DOC_ATTACH_ID}) FROM DUAL) = 'E-TL0503' THEN 'VALID_M1604' ELSE 'OK' END AS MSG FROM DUAL

SELECT ' ' AS INPUTSKU, #{OWNRKY} AS OWNRKY, (SELECT NAME01 FROM OWNER WHERE OWNRKY = #{OWNRKY}) AS OWNRNM, ' ' AS SKUKEY, ' ' AS DESC01, ' ' AS DESC02, ' ' AS SKUG05, ' ' AS QTYORD, ' ' AS UOMKEY, ' ' AS QTSIWH, ' ' AS QTTTWH, ' ' AS MATNR, ' ' AS LOTA10, 0 AS LOTA16, 0 AS LOTA17, ' ' AS TEXT, ' ' AS COSTCT, ' ' AS DOCTXT, ' ' AS ASKU05, ' ' AS RSNCOD, ' ' AS TASRSN, ' ' AS WORKID, ' ' AS STDLNR, ' ' AS C00101 FROM DUAL
SELECT SKUKEY , DESC01 , DESC02 , DESC04 , SKUG05 FROM SKUMA WHERE OWNRKY = #{OWNRKY} AND (SKUKEY LIKE '%${SKUKEY}%' OR DESC01 LIKE '%${SKUKEY}%')

SELECT SM.SKUKEY AS SKUKEY , SM.SKUKEY AS INPUTSKU , NVL(BM.MATNR, ' ') AS MATNR , SM.DESC01 AS DESC01 , SM.DESC02 AS DESC02 , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY , SM.ASKU05 AS ASKU05 , SM.SKUG05 AS SKUG05 , NVL(( SELECT SUM(QTSIWH) AS QTSIWH FROM STKKY ST WHERE WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND OWNRKY = SM.OWNRKY AND AREAKY = #{AREAKY} AND SKUKEY = SM.SKUKEY AND QTSIWH - GREATEST(QTSALO,QTSPMO) - QTSBLK > 0 AND QTSIWH > 0 AND LOTA06 = '00' AND AREAKY NOT IN ('V05') ),0) AS QTSIWH , NVL(( SELECT SUM(QTSIWH) AS QTSIWH FROM STKKY ST WHERE WAREKY = 'WH01' AND OWNRKY = SM.OWNRKY AND AREAKY = 'V05' AND SKUKEY = SM.SKUKEY AND QTSIWH - GREATEST(QTSALO,QTSPMO) - QTSBLK > 0 AND QTSIWH > 0 AND LOTA06 = '00' ),0) AS QTTTWH , ' ' AS RSNCOD , ' ' AS TASRSN , ' ' AS COSTCT , 0 AS QTYORD , ' ' AS DOCTXT , ' ' AS LOTA10 , 0 AS LOTA16 , 0 AS LOTA17 , #{OWNRKY} AS OWNRKY , (SELECT NAME01 FROM OWNER O WHERE O.OWNRKY = #{OWNRKY}) AS OWNRNM , ' ' AS TEXT FROM SKUMA SM, Z_SKUUSR UR, BUYER BM WHERE SM.OWNRKY = UR.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = UR.SKUKEY AND UR.USERID = #{USERID} AND SM.OWNRKY = #{OWNRKY} AND SM.SKUKEY = BM.SKUKEY(+)

SELECT SR.SHPRQK AS SHPRQK, SR.SHPRQI AS SHPRQI, SR.SKUKEY AS SKUKEY, SM.DESC01 AS DESC01, SM.DESC02 AS DESC02, SM.SKUG05 AS SKUG05, SR.QTYORD AS QTYORD, SR.UOMKEY AS UOMKEY, CASE WHEN TRIM(SR.TRNSHP) IS NOT NULL THEN NVL((SELECT QTSHPO FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.TRNSHP AND SHPOIT = SR.TRNSHI),0) ELSE 0 END AS QTYTRN, CASE WHEN TRIM(SR.TRNSHP) IS NOT NULL THEN NVL((SELECT QTSHPO FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.TRNSHP AND SHPOIT = SR.TRNSHI),0) ELSE 0 END AS QTYTRS, NVL((SELECT MENGE_R FROM IFWMS103 WHERE WERKS = SR.OWNRKY AND (USRID2,DEPTID2) IN (SELECT SVBELN,SPOSNR FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.TRNSHP AND SHPOIT = SR.TRNSHI) AND STATUS IN ('A','C') AND IFFLG IN ('N','Y')),0) AS QTYTRR, NVL((SELECT QTALOC FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.SHPOKY AND SHPOIT = SR.SHPOIT),0) AS QTALOC, NVL((SELECT QTJCMP FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.SHPOKY AND SHPOIT = SR.SHPOIT),0) AS QTJCMP, NVL((SELECT QTSHPD FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.SHPOKY AND SHPOIT = SR.SHPOIT),0) AS QTSHPD, SR.QTYORD - NVL((SELECT QTSHPD FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.SHPOKY AND SHPOIT = SR.SHPOIT),0) AS QTUSHP, SR.TRNSHP AS TRNSHP, SR.TRNSHI AS TRNSHI, SR.SHPOKY AS SHPOKY, SR.SHPOIT AS SHPOIT, SR.LOTA09 AS MATNR, SR.LOTA10 AS LOTA10, SR.LOTA16 AS LOTA16, SR.LOTA17 AS LOTA17, SR.LOTA02 AS LOTA02, SR.RSNCOD AS RSNCOD, SR.TASRSN AS TASRSN, SR.DOCTXT AS DOCTXT FROM SHPRQ SR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = SR.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = SR.SKUKEY INNER JOIN BZPTN VD ON VD.OWNRKY = SR.OWNRKY AND VD.PTNRKY = SR.DPTNKY AND VD.PTNRTY = 'CT' WHERE 1 = 1
AND SHPRQK = #{SHPRQK}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TH.TASKKY) AS CNT FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND TI.STATIT IN ('PPC', 'FPC') AND TI.QTTAOR > 0 AND DECODE(#{DOTYPE}, '1', TI.SHPOKY, '2', TI.DOORKY) = #{DOORKY}

SELECT TH.DOCCAT AS DOCCAT , TH.TASOTY AS DOCUTY , TH.TASKKY AS DOCUKY , TH.TASKKY AS TASKKY , TI.TASKIT AS TASKIT , TI.SHPOKY AS SHPOKY , TI.SHPOIT AS SHPOIT , NVL((SELECT AREAKY FROM LOCMA WHERE WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR),' ') AS AREAKY , TI.LOCASR , TI.SKUKEY , TI.DESC01 , SUM(TI.QTTAOR) AS QTTAOR , SUM(TI.QTTAOR) AS QTCOMP , TI.SUOMKY AS UOMKEY , TI.DOORKY AS DOORKY FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND TI.STATIT IN ('PPC', 'FPC') AND TI.QTTAOR > 0 AND DECODE(#{DOTYPE}, '1', TI.SHPOKY, '2', TI.DOORKY) = #{DOORKY} GROUP BY TH.DOCCAT , TH.TASOTY , TH.TASKKY , TI.TASKIT , TI.SHPOKY , TI.SHPOIT , TI.LOCASR , TI.SKUKEY , TI.DESC01 , TI.SUOMKY , TI.DOORKY , TH.WAREKY
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO WKSIGN A USING DUAL ON (A.DOCCAT = #{DOCCAT} AND A.DOCUTY = #{DOCUTY} AND A.DOCUKY = #{DOCUKY}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.SIGNFL = #{SIGNFL} , A.LMODAT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , A.LMOTIM = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') , A.LMOUSR = #{SES_USER_ID} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( DOCCAT, DOCUTY, DOCUKY, SIGNFL, CREDAT, CRETIM, CREUSR, LMODAT, LMOTIM, LMOUSR, INDBZL, INDARC, UPDCHK ) VALUES ( #{DOCCAT}, #{DOCUTY}, #{DOCUKY}, #{SIGNFL}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{SES_USER_ID}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{SES_USER_ID}, NVL(#{INDBZL}, ' '), NVL(#{INDARC}, ' '), NVL(#{UPDCHK}, 0) )

SELECT W002.WERKS AS WERKS , W002.PRFM_DT AS PRFM_DT --실적일자 , W002.IND_BCD AS IND_BCD --개별바코드 , W002.LOT_NO AS LOT_NO --LOT NO , W002.MATNR AS MATNR , M001.MATNR_NM AS MATNR_NM , M001.BS_WGT AS BS_WGT --평량 , W002.WGT AS WGT --총중량 , case when Q020.PRC_SEQNO is not null then 'Y' else 'N' end AS INSP_YN -- 점보롤 검사여부 , case when Q021.RST_VAL is null or Q021.RST_VAL = 0 then 'N' else TO_CHAR(Q021.RST_VAL, 'FM9999990.00') end AS DUSTDATA -- 지분검사여부 및 데이터 , W002.MACH_CD AS MACH_CD , M012.MACH_NM AS MACH_NM , S006.MACHINE AS MACHINE --생산호기 , S006.MACHINETXT AS MACHINETXT --생산호기명 FROM TB_WRK002 W002 left join TB_MAS001 M001 on W002.MATNR = M001.MATNR AND W002.WERKS = M001.WERKS left join TB_MAS012 M012 on W002.MACH_CD = M012.MACH_CD left join TB_SCH006 S006 on W002.ORDER_NO = S006.AUFNR left join TB_QLT020 Q020 on Q020.WERKS = W002.WERKS AND Q020.MATNR = W002.MATNR AND Q020.LOT_NO = W002.LOT_NO AND Q020.IND_BCD = W002.IND_BCD LEFT JOIN TB_QLT021 Q021 ON Q021.MSRM_DATE = Q020.MSRM_DATE and Q020.PRC_SEQNO = Q021.PRC_SEQNO and q020.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = q021.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD and INSP_ITEM_CD = #{INSP_ITEM_CD} WHERE 1=1 AND W002.WERKS = #{WERKS} AND NVL(W002.CNL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND W002.PRFM_DT BETWEEN #{PRFM_DT_STRT} AND #{PRFM_DT_END} AND W002.MATNR LIKE '%-00000000'
AND S006.MACHINE = #{MACHINE}
AND Q021.RST_VAL IS NOT NULL AND Q021.RST_VAL != 0
AND (Q021.RST_VAL IS NULL OR Q021.RST_VAL = 0)
ORDER BY W002.PRD_STR_DATE

SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS NEW_MSRM_DATE , TO_CHAR(Q020.MSRM_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS OLD_MSRM_DATE , NVL(PRC_SEQNO, 1) AS PRC_SEQNO , WRK002.MATNR AS MATNR FROM TB_WRK002 WRK002 LEFT JOIN TB_QLT020 Q020 ON Q020.WERKS = WRK002.WERKS AND Q020.IND_BCD = WRK002.IND_BCD AND Q020.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = #{INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD} WHERE 1=1 AND WRK002.WERKS = #{WERKS} AND WRK002.IND_BCD = #{IND_BCD}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO tb_qlt020 t USING ( SELECT WRK002.WERKS , WRK002.IND_BCD , WRK002.LOT_NO , CASE WHEN MAS001.DOMESTIC = 'Y' THEN '01' WHEN MAS001.DOMESTIC = 'N' THEN '02' ELSE NULL END AS REQ_DIV FROM TB_WRK002 WRK002 LEFT JOIN TB_MAS001 MAS001 ON WRK002.MATNR = MAS001.MATNR AND WRK002.WERKS = MAS001.WERKS WHERE 1=1 AND WRK002.WERKS = #{WERKS} AND WRK002.IND_BCD = #{IND_BCD} ) S ON ( t.WERKS = S.WERKS AND t.IND_BCD = S.IND_BCD AND t.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = #{INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD} ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.MSRM_DATE = TO_DATE(#{NEW_MSRM_DATE}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , t.UPDDATE = SYSDATE , t.UPDID = #{REGID} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT --검사항목별 측정결과 마스터 ( INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD --검사항목그룹코드 , MATNR --품목코드 , WERKS --플랜트코드 , MSRM_DATE --측정일시 , PRC_SEQNO --처리순번 , MSRM_ID --측정자 , FNL_JDGM --최종판정 , LOT_NO --로트번호 , IND_BCD --개별바코드 , REQ_DIV --요청구분(01:국내자재, 02:수입자재, 03:반품입고) , PRC_DIV --처리구분(I:개별, M:다중) , REGDATE --REGDATE , REGID --REGID ) VALUES ( #{INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD} , #{MATNR} , S.WERKS , TO_DATE(#{NEW_MSRM_DATE}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , #{PRC_SEQNO} , #{REGID} , 'PASS' , S.LOT_NO , S.IND_BCD , S.REQ_DIV , 'I' , SYSDATE , #{REGID} )
